task_instructions: When a Pydantic model is configured with extra='allow' and a field has an alias, supplying both the alias key and the field name key in input data causes model_dump() to overwrite the validated field value with the extra field value during serialization. Fix serialization so that validated field values are preserved and extra fields do not overwrite declared fields.
expected_behavior: model_dump() must output the validated field value for the declared field, and extra fields must not overwrite the declared field. When by_alias=True, non-colliding extra fields can coexist. model_dump_json() must produce valid JSON with unique keys.
